title: Variance
text: Variance of input or sequence of inputs, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset event; {Running variance} sets the option to select running variance, {Find the variance value over} sets the dimension over which variance is computed Each, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension, {Input processing} sets the method to process the input in running mode Columns, {Rounding mode} sets the method of rounding, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Input-squared product output} sets the data type of the input-squared term Same, {Input-sum-squared product} sets the data type of the input-sum-squared term Same as input-squared, {Accumulator}, {Output} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Data input vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Variance along the specified dimension scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Running variance
params.values: Option to select running variance off (default) | on

params.name: Find the variance value over
params.values: Dimension over which variance is computed Each column (default) | Entire input | Each row | Specified dimension

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input in running mode Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Input-squared product output
params.values: Data type of the input-squared term Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Input-sum-squared product
params.values: Data type of the input-sum-squared term Same as input-squared product (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Same as input-squared product (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Same as input-squared product (default) | Same as accumulator | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
